terminology.binaryDeserialization: SaveManager.Load/LoadContext.Load constructs, resolves and fills the root graph before returning LoadResult.

newGameOrder: GameLoadingState.OnTick -> SandBoxGameManager.DoLoadingForGameManager: LoadModuleData(false), no-argument StartNewGame engine bridge, MBGlobals.InitializeReferences, CampaignCreatorDelegate.Invoke -> Game.CreateGame.

Game.CreateGame: MBObjectManager.Init -> Game.RegisterTypes (GameType.BeforeRegisterTypes, core registrations, GameType.OnRegisterTypes, manager.RegisterSubModuleTypes) -> Game constructor/BeginLoading.

Campaign loading Initialize -> Game.Initialize -> Campaign.OnInitialize: events/managers -> SandBoxManager.Initialize(default models/behaviors) -> manager.InitializeGameStarter -> manager.OnGameStart -> basic/campaign model managers.

BeginGameStart -> OnNewCampaignStart -> default campaign objects/Game.InitializeDefaultGameObjects (InitializeSubModuleGameObjects), basic XML, main party/managers -> CreateLists -> cultures/concepts XML -> manager.OnNewCampaignStart.

SandBoxManager.OnCampaignStart -> manager.RegisterSubModuleObjects(false) -> AfterRegisterSubModuleObjects(false); SandBox loads NPCCharacters, Heroes, Kingdoms, Factions, WorkshopTypes, LocationComplexTemplates, Settlements (campaign mode and not edit mode).
Behavior setup/new-game campaign objects -> Game.OnGameStart -> manager.OnGameInitializationFinished; SandBox assigns default MapSceneCreator here.

Later Campaign loading stage -> LoadMapScene: CreateMapScene -> SetSceneLevels -> Load -> map bounds -> AfterLoad. Data/caches, new-game/session callbacks and OnAfterGameInitializationFinished follow; manager.OnLoadFinished launches normal character creation/intro.
savedGameOrder: Owned preflight candidate BEFORE MBSaveLoad.LoadSaveGameData(saveName); normal-menu interception and generated identity injection are not established.

MBSaveLoad.LoadSaveGameData -> SaveManager.Load(name,driver,true) -> DefinitionContext.FillWithCurrentTypes -> driver.Load -> LoadContext.Load. Root is created/resolved/filled here; parallel work exists. Deferred initialization callback holder returned in LoadResult.
new SandBoxGameManager(LoadResult) -> MBGameManager.StartNewGame(manager) -> GameLoadingState -> SandBoxGameManager loading with LoadModuleData(true) and MBGlobals.InitializeReferences.

Game.LoadSaveGame: MBSaveLoad.OnStartGame -> MBObjectManager.Init -> result.Root/GameType -> Game.RegisterTypes -> result.InitializeObjects -> manager.ReInitialize -> result.AfterInitializeObjects -> GC -> assign Game.ObjectManager -> BeginLoading.

Game.Initialize/Campaign.OnInitialize rebuilds model managers and default campaign objects, XML and behaviors. RegisterSubModuleObjects(true) skips Heroes/Kingdoms/Factions in SandBox XML, but still loads NPCCharacters and campaign Settlements. OnGameLoaded -> InitializeCampaignBehaviors -> LoadBehaviorData -> RegisterEvents precede initialization-finished/map load.

Campaign later loads map, checks map update, data/caches, OnAfterGameLoaded, OnGameLoaded/session events and OnAfterGameInitializationFinished; SandBoxGameManager.OnLoadFinished restores MapState/menu/encounter and emits OnGameLoadFinished.
